analysis.reasonEn: Five consecutive down days recently, with daily RSI falling to 30.3 into oversold territory. ADX at 11.7 indicates no trend formation, and -DI is higher than +DI suggesting downside pressure, but it's not a confirmed trend, hence maintaining a wait-and-see approach. Weekly RSI at 42.6 remains in weak territory. Despite volume surge on five straight days of decline, trend reversal signals are weak.
